results.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet, claiming it's a safe way to have AI shop for you
results.content: According to OpenAI, ChatGPT Wallet will let AI agents make purchases for users without sharing their credit card information each time. In addition, "security checks" are required for every purchase an AI agent makes. This entails a human user manually reviewing and approving every purchase.
